import sys
import os

class ProblemB:
    def solve(self, a, out):
        i = 0
        one = 0
        two = 0
        inside_parenthesis = False
        n = len(a)
        while i != n:
            if a[i] == '(':
                inside_parenthesis = True
            elif a[i] == ')':
                inside_parenthesis = False
            elif a[i].isalpha():
                i -= 1
            if inside_parenthesis:
                i += 1
                while i != n and a[i] != ')' and not a[i].isalpha():
                    i += 1
                if i == n or not a[i].isalpha():
                    continue
                i += 1
                while i != n and a[i].isalpha():
                    i += 1
                two += 1
            else:
                i += 1
                while i != n and a[i] != '(' and not a[i].isalpha():
                    i += 1
                if i == n or not a[i].isalpha():
                    continue
                j = i
                i += 1
                while i != n and a[i].isalpha():
                    i += 1
                one = max(one, i - j)
        out.write(f"{one} {two}\n")

def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if args:
        input_stream = open(args[0], 'r')
    else:
        input_stream = sys.stdin
    with input_stream as f:
        f.readline()
        line = f.readline().rstrip('\n')
        out = sys.stdout
        ProblemB().solve(list(line), out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
